Edgar Rice Burroughs, Pellucidar.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/edgar-rice-burroughs/pellucidar

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Edgar Rice Burroughs, the author, died 1950 (Wikidata Q148234, P570 = 1950-03-19).

First publication of the text used: 1915, in the United States; first edition 1915, United States (country field of the Pellucidar article). SE colophon: 'Pellucidar was published in 1915 by Edgar Rice Burroughs.'

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1915, before 1931; a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after publication, so this work entered it in 2010.
- Country of origin (United States): the country of first publication is the United States, so the rule above settles the country of origin too.
